possibilities.connection: Unsloth's 1-bit quant claims 91% top-1 retention, but that check does not measure repetition loops, and Boo Bench's 179 loop-triggering pages plus llama.cpp's fixed reasoning budget make a cheap, predictable loop test for local runs.

possibilities.title: Consultants can pilot Mistral Large 4 on a Mac Studio, then scale identical weights
possibilities.connection: On 2026-10-22 Magpie suggested consultants pilot DeepSeek on one Mac in a law firm and then scale the same model unchanged; today Unsloth's 223GB 1-bit quant puts the 1T Mistral Large 4 on a Mac Studio while the same weights serve in vLLM and fine-tune with LoRA in Axolotl, so the pilot can now cover scanned documents and a firm-specific tune without a model change later.
